notes.title: demo v1.09
notes.content:
1. New talent added: Poison Master, relatively easy to master, can deal a large amount of damage by stacking poison damage and poison layers
2. Increase the random occurrence of sand worms, which will indiscriminately attack any living organism
After 3 waves, you will automatically receive props on the field
4. Reduce the cooling of some soul stones and strengthen the epic!
5 Other optimizations, bug fixes

notes.title: Twilight Canyon demo v1.08
notes.content:
1. Add the final boss (because it is very mysterious, there is no cover image), the developer's highest masterpiece! The first boss with full screen flash kill skill! Only adventurers standing at the top of Twilight Valley can witness its true form!
2. New rewards have been added for "Magic Circulation", "Shake Music", and "Dance Steps of Time". After receiving the "Dance of Time" reward, if attacked during the invincible evasion time, a "pause" state will be applied to all enemies.
3. Now hold down the left mouse button to automatically launch consecutive normal attacks;
4. Other optimizations

notes.title: Twilight Canyon v1.06
Twilight Canyon demo v1.05
Twilight Canyon demo v1.03
notes.content:
Fixed bugs: 1. Fixed a bug where the store did not disappear after ending a transaction; 2. Fixed a bug with abnormal damage enhancements after using soul stones.
Optimizations: 1. Reduced the windup and follow-through times for basic attacks and dodges; 2. Increased the attack range of soul stones and significantly reduced their cooldown time; 3. Optimized the UI for certain types of cards; 4. Optimized the logic for players receiving rewards, ensuring that they don't receive rewards that do not enhance their current build; 5. Ensured that specific items always appear in the store; 6. Added key explanations to the start interface.
